table_requires: Net loss attributable to common stockholders
(In thousands, except for share and per share values)
paragraph_requires: The Company computes diluted net income per share under a two-class method
The following potentially dilutive shares were excluded from the computation
decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, The Honest Company uses net loss attributable to common stockholders as its EPS numerator; the separate 2023 comprehensive-loss figure does not replace it. Its dilution policy describes two-class allocation and the treasury-stock method for options. The filing excludes the listed potentially dilutive shares as anti-dilutive. Shares and per-share amounts are exempt from the thousands heading and retain scale-zero tags; excluded instruments are not added to the denominator.

table_requires: In USD thousands, except share and per share data
paragraph_requires: Diluted net loss per share is the same as basic net loss per share
The ADS Ratio Change did not affect the number of the Company’s issued and outstanding Ordinary Shares
All ADS amounts and per-ADS amounts presented
decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Chemomab presents loss per ordinary share as a positive loss amount; the original values and signs are retained rather than converted into positive earnings or silently negated. Potential ordinary-share dilution is excluded as anti-dilutive. The August 2025 ADS ratio change from 20 to 80 ordinary shares per ADS did not change ordinary-share counts; retrospective adjustment applies to ADS and per-ADS amounts. These selected figures remain ordinary-share measures with full scale-zero counts and scale-zero per-share tags, without ADS conversion.
